privacyUsageDesc: We personalize the experience, display progress, validate premium access, troubleshoot issues, and serve Google AdMob ads.

exercise_box_breathing_desc: Regulate your breath in four stages: inhale, hold, exhale, and wait. Builds mental balance.
exercise_box_breathing_step1: Take a slow and soft breath (4 sec)
exercise_box_breathing_step3: Slowly release it through your mouth (4 sec)
exercise_box_breathing_step4: Wait calmly before the next cycle (4 sec)
exercise_simple_counting_desc: Focus on counting while breathing in and out. Helps gather the mind.
exercise_simple_counting_step1: Breathe in slowly while counting to 4 (4 sec)
exercise_simple_counting_step2: Exhale calmly while counting in your mind (4 sec)
exercise_awareness_desc: Observe your breath in its natural flow. Simply notice without changing anything.
exercise_awareness_step1: Breathe in softly without force (4 sec)
exercise_awareness_step2: Let the breath flow out slowly by itself (4 sec)
exercise_extended_exhale_desc: Short inhale, long exhale. This rhythm gently calms the nervous system.
exercise_extended_exhale_step1: Take a calm and soft breath (4 sec)
exercise_extended_exhale_step2: Release your breath gently over a longer time (6 sec)
exercise_diaphragm_desc: Breathe into your belly. Belly breathing instead of chest breathing reduces stress.
exercise_diaphragm_step1: Slowly breathe into your belly, keeping chest still (5 sec)
exercise_diaphragm_step2: Exhale calmly from your belly (5 sec)
exercise_equal_breath_desc: Balance your nervous system by equalizing inhale and exhale durations.
exercise_equal_breath_step1: Take a balanced, slow breath without tension (5 sec)
exercise_equal_breath_step2: Release it softly over the same duration (5 sec)
exercise_slowing_desc: Slowing the breath rhythm lowers heart rate and prepares for sleep.
exercise_slowing_step1: Breathe in calmly without tensing up (4 sec)
exercise_slowing_step2: Let your breath out very slowly and long (8 sec)
exercise_body_awareness_desc: Focus on different parts of your body while breathing to release tension.
exercise_body_awareness_step1: Feel your body as you breathe in slowly (5 sec)
exercise_body_awareness_step2: Release all tension along with your breath (5 sec)
exercise_relaxation_desc: Creates a deep sense of relaxation and eases the transition to sleep.
exercise_relaxation_step1: Take a soft and slow breath without force (6 sec)
exercise_relaxation_step2: Relax your shoulders as you exhale (6 sec)
exercise_energizing_diaphragm_desc: Deep diaphragm breathing fills the body with energy.
exercise_energizing_diaphragm_step1: Take a lively but slow belly breath (5 sec)
exercise_morning_breath_desc: Start the day with deep, lively breaths. Boosts your morning energy.
exercise_morning_breath_step1: Take a relaxing, soft, and calm breath (4 sec)
exercise_morning_breath_step2: Blow away your sleepy feeling with your breath (4 sec)
exercise_day_start_desc: Breathe in positive energy, exhale lightly. Sets you up for the day.
exercise_day_start_step1: Take a slow and positive breath without effort (5 sec)
exercise_day_start_step2: Let your breath go lightly and calmly (3 sec)
